# XingAI Tech Blog

- URL: https://blog.xingai.app
- Product: Public engineering archive for XingAI decision-system products
- Publisher: XingAI (https://xingai.app)
- Languages: UI in English, 中文, 한국어. Articles in English and 中文.

## Main user flow

1. Open https://blog.xingai.app
2. Pick a post from the latest list or /posts
3. Read the English or 中文 article
4. Filter by tag when you want one topic (MCP, CQRS, ADR, etc.)

## What this is

Engineering notes about how XingAI products are built: cache boundaries, MCP gates, Fly/Vercel hosting, ADRs. The Markdown source lives in https://github.com/xingaiapp/xingai-tech-blog.

This is not an investing blog and not a product funnel. Product apps live on their own domains (invest.xingai.app, research.xingai.app, cook.xingai.app, and others listed on xingai.app).

## FAQ

Q: What is XingAI Tech Blog?
A: A public archive of engineering posts from XingAI, published at blog.xingai.app and as Markdown on GitHub.

Q: Which languages are supported?
A: UI: English, 中文, 한국어. Articles: English and 中文.

Q: Is this investment advice?
A: No. Posts are engineering notes. Product outputs are suggestions, not professional advice.

Q: How is content licensed?
A: Posts are CC BY 4.0 unless a post says otherwise.
